## Control The Playback

### Playback Status

To know the status of the playback,
issue the `playback status` command:

```bash
volumito playback status
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:06:59",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 1,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:02:23.417",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Nella mia città",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 55
}
```

A tabular format can also be output:

```bash
volumito playback status --format table
Volumio Status
==================================================
Status              : play
Position            : 1
Title               : Nella mia città
Artist              : Mango
Album               : Sirtaki
Duration            : 00:06:59
Seek                : 00:02:23.918
Volume              : 55
Mute                : False
Tracktype           : flac
Samplerate          : 44.1 kHz
Bitdepth            : 16 bit
Channels            : 2
```

as well as selecting all the fields present in the response
from the REST API:

```bash
volumito playback status --fields ALL
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "albumart": "/albumart?cacheid=208&web=Mango/Sirtaki/extralarge&path=%2FINTERNAL%2Fmusic%2FMango%2FSirtaki&metadata=false",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "consume": false,
    "dbVolume": null,
    "disableVolumeControl": false,
    "duration": "00:06:59",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 1,
    "random": false,
    "repeat": false,
    "repeatSingle": false,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:02:24.668",
    "service": "mpd",
    "status": "play",
    "stream": "flac",
    "title": "Nella mia città",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "updatedb": false,
    "uri": "mnt/INTERNAL/music/Mango/Sirtaki/001___Nella_mia_città.flac",
    "volatile": false,
    "volume": 55
}
```

> [!TIP]
> The `-F / --format` and `-L / --fields` options
> apply to several other `volumito` commands.
>
> Mind that built-in constants like `ALL` or `SHORT`
> are spelled uppercased: `-L all` selects the field `all`,
> while `-L ALL` selects all fields.

> [!TIP]
> If the `-m / --machine-readable` option is given,
> the `volumito` output is always produced as valid JSON
> that can be consumed by a downstream application.

```bash
volumito -m playback status -F raw -L ALL
{"status": "play", "position": 0, "title": "Nella mia citt\u00e0", "artist": "Mango", "album": "Sirtaki", "albumart": "/albumart?cacheid=208&web=Mango/Sirtaki/extralarge&path=%2FINTERNAL%2Fmusic%2FMango%2FSirtaki&metadata=false", "uri": "mnt/INTERNAL/music/Mango/Sirtaki/001___Nella_mia_citt\u00e0.flac", "trackType": "flac", "seek": 145168, "duration": 419, "samplerate": "44.1 kHz", "bitdepth": "16 bit", "channels": 2, "random": false, "repeat": false, "repeatSingle": false, "consume": false, "volume": 55, "dbVolume": null, "disableVolumeControl": false, "mute": false, "stream": "flac", "updatedb": false, "volatile": false, "service": "mpd"}
```

### Pause And Stop

To pause the playback, use `playback pause`:

```bash
volumito playback pause
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:06:59",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 1,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:02:25.918",
    "status": "pause",
    "title": "Nella mia città",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 55
}
[2026-09-08T08:46:48.888Z] [INFO] Command 'pause' executed successfully
```

By default, the resulting status of the playback is printed.
This behavior is controlled by the option
`-r, --print-resulting-status / --no-print-resulting-status`.

To toggle between pause and play, use `playback toggle`:

```bash
volumito playback toggle
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:06:59",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 1,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:02:27.919",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Nella mia città",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 55
}
[2026-09-08T08:46:51.522Z] [INFO] Command 'toggle' executed successfully
```

To stop the playback, use `playback stop`:

```bash
volumito playback stop
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:06:59",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 1,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:00:00.252",
    "status": "stop",
    "title": "Nella mia città",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 55
}
[2026-09-08T08:46:54.162Z] [INFO] Command 'stop' executed successfully
```

### Play Track At A Given Position

The `playback play` command starts playing the current queue.

```bash
volumito playback play
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:06:59",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 1,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:00:02.001",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Nella mia città",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 55
}
[2026-09-08T08:46:56.778Z] [INFO] Command 'play' executed successfully
```

It accepts an optional positional argument
that can be used to specify the position in the queue
of the track to be played.
For example, to play the third track:

```bash
volumito playback play 3
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:05:18",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 3,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:00:03.096",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Terra bianca",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 55
}
[2026-09-08T08:46:59.450Z] [INFO] Command 'play' executed successfully
```

### Seeking

The playback position within the current track
can be queried with `playback seek`:

```bash
volumito playback seek
00:00:03.598
```

and it can be set by providing a new value,
either in seconds:

```bash
volumito playback seek 42
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:05:18",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 3,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:00:43.944",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Terra bianca",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 55
}
[2026-09-08T08:47:02.671Z] [INFO] Command 'seek 42' executed successfully
```

or in `HH:MM:SS` format:

```bash
volumito playback seek 00:01:42
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:05:18",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 3,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:01:44.001",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Terra bianca",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 55
}
[2026-09-08T08:47:05.611Z] [INFO] Command 'seek 102' executed successfully
```

or `plus/increase/up/forward` and `minus/decrease/down/backward`:

```bash
volumito playback seek forward
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:05:18",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 3,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:01:56.723",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Terra bianca",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 55
}
[2026-09-08T08:47:08.263Z] [INFO] Command 'seek plus' executed successfully
```

```bash
volumito playback seek minus
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:05:18",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 3,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:01:50.503",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Terra bianca",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 55
}
[2026-09-08T08:47:10.907Z] [INFO] Command 'seek minus' executed successfully
```

### Volume Control

The current volume level,
expressed as an integer between `0` and `100`,
can be queried with `playback volume`:

```bash
volumito playback volume
55
```

and it can be set by providing a new value, either numerical:

```bash
volumito playback volume 20
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:05:18",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 3,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:01:54.525",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Terra bianca",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 20
}
[2026-09-08T08:47:14.114Z] [INFO] Command 'volume 20' executed successfully
```

or `plus/increase/up` and `minus/decrease/down`:

```bash
volumito playback volume plus
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:05:18",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 3,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:01:57.181",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Terra bianca",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 20
}
[2026-09-08T08:47:16.767Z] [INFO] Command 'volume plus' executed successfully
```

```bash
volumito playback volume down
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:05:18",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 3,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:01:59.796",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Terra bianca",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 19
}
[2026-09-08T08:47:19.405Z] [INFO] Command 'volume minus' executed successfully
```

The playback volume can be muted and unmuted with
`playback mute` and `playback unmute`:

```bash
volumito playback mute
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:05:18",
    "mute": true,
    "position": 3,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:02:02.546",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Terra bianca",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 19
}
[2026-09-08T08:47:22.040Z] [INFO] Command 'volume mute' executed successfully
```

```bash
volumito playback unmute
{
    "album": "Sirtaki",
    "artist": "Mango",
    "bitdepth": "16 bit",
    "channels": 2,
    "duration": "00:05:18",
    "mute": false,
    "position": 3,
    "samplerate": "44.1 kHz",
    "seek": "00:02:05.160",
    "status": "play",
    "title": "Terra bianca",
    "trackType": "flac",
    "volume": 19
}
[2026-09-08T08:47:24.702Z] [INFO] Command 'volume unmute' executed successfully
```

### Playback Help

These are all the subcommands of the `playback` group:

```bash
volumito playback --help
Usage: volumito playback [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Control the playback.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  infinity    Print or set the infinity playback mode.
  is_muted    Print whether the volume is muted.
  is_paused   Print whether the playback is paused.
  is_playing  Print whether the playback is playing.
  is_stopped  Print whether the playback is stopped.
  mute        Mute the volume.
  next        Skip to the next track.
  pause       Pause playback.
  play        Start playback.
  previous    Skip to the previous track.
  seek        Print, set, or adjust the seek position.
  sleep       Print, arm, or disarm the sleep timer.
  status      Print the playback status.
  stop        Stop playback.
  toggle      Toggle between play and pause states.
  unmute      Unmute the volume.
  volume      Print, set, or adjust the volume.
```
